dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents between 01 and 05 March 2025 over South Sudan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250110SSD** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water using VIIRS in South Sudan between 01 to 05 March 2025 compared with the period from 01 to 05 February 2025 . Within the cloud free analysed areas of about 630,000 km², a total of about 23,000 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. Water extent appears to have decreased of about 14,000 km² since the period between 01 to 05 February 2025 within the cloud free analysed areas. Based on Worldpop population data and the maximal flood water extent ~390,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
